description: Use this for any "how long will this stay on my credit report" question. Returns retention periods on a Canadian credit file: closed accounts, late payments, collections, hard inquiries, bankruptcy, consumer proposals, judgments. Durations differ by information type, bureau, and province. Returns those distinctions and source links. Returns bundled reference material, optionally filtered or calculated from inputs; does not fetch live data or change accounts.
name: explain_retention_periods
title: How long things stay on a Canadian credit file
